title: Concatenation of polynomial-time functions
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions from binary strings to binary strings. Then the function sending $x$ to the concatenation $f(x)g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a polynomial-time computable function on binary strings
$g$ is a polynomial-time computable function on binary strings
replaced:
If $f$ and $g$ are polynomial-time computable functions on binary strings, then
so is $x \mapsto f(x) \mathbin{+\!\!+} g(x)$.
